normalized_claims: Facts are current as of 2026-10-04 08:00 UTC+08:00.
3.2.0 is the released stable version, released 2026-09-24.
3.2.1 was offered on 2026-10-02 only to macOS accounts already approved for preview.
critical_negations: 3.2.1 is not an all-platform stable release.
unknown_fields: Dates for unreleased features or patches on other platforms.

source_evidence.quote: 截至2026-10-04 08:00 UTC+08:00，已发布稳定版为3.2.0，发布日期2026-09-24。3.2.1于2026-10-02仅向已获准加入预览的macOS账号提供，不是全平台稳定版。未给任何未发布功能或其他平台补丁的承诺日期。

normalized_claims: In 3.2.0 every plan has an inclusive per-file maximum of 25 MiB, batch maximum of 8 files, and batch total maximum of 100 MiB.
All three limits apply simultaneously.
1 MiB equals 2^20 bytes.
critical_negations: Do not replace MiB with MB.
The per-file cap is not the batch cap.
The former 3.1 limit of 10 MB is not current 3.2.0 policy.

source_evidence.quote: 3.2.0对所有套餐统一按每个文件不超过25 MiB、每批不超过8个文件、每批总量不超过100 MiB校验，三项须同时满足，边界值可取。MiB为2^20字节，不能改写为MB或把每文件上限当总量。3.1中的10 MB旧口径不再作为3.2.0的当前限制。

normalized_claims: In 3.2.0 CSV export limits per export are Starter 500, Team 10000, Enterprise 50000 rows, inclusive.
CSV contains text fields and metadata only.
Role permission in F07 applies in addition to plan limits.
critical_negations: CSV does not include attachments, binary content, or the complete workspace.
Exports are not unlimited.
Enough plan rows alone do not confer export permission.

source_evidence.quote: 3.2.0已向Starter/Team/Enterprise分别提供每次500/10000/50000行的CSV导出，上限含边界。CSV只包含文本字段与元数据，不打包附件、二进制内容或完整工作空间。导出还受F07角色权限约束，不能把套餐行数足够当成已有导出权限，也不是无限行数。

normalized_claims: 3.2.0 supports PDFs with extractable text.
Scanned pages and image-only PDFs need OCR.
A user may provide an extractable-text version or text content instead.
critical_negations: OCR is unreleased both in stable and 3.2.1 preview.
Support cannot claim OCR has been completed or an unreleased feature enabled.

source_evidence.quote: 3.2.0支持可提取文本的PDF。扫描页、纯图片PDF需要OCR，该功能在稳定版及3.2.1预览中均未发布，也无承诺上线日期。可请用户提供可提取文本的版本或文字内容，但不能声称已为其完成OCR或启用了未发布功能。

normalized_claims: Windows 3.2.0 has a known duplicate-sync-record issue.
Temporary workaround: first save separate copies of unsynced drafts, then close and reopen the affected document, then retry sync once.
critical_negations: This workaround is not a released fix.
Do not delete caches or workspaces or overwrite unsynced content.
macOS-only 3.2.1 preview does not establish a Windows fix.

source_evidence.quote: Windows 3.2.0存在重复同步记录的已知问题。临时绕过步骤为先把未同步草稿另存副本，再关闭并重新打开受影响文档，最后重试同步一次；这不是已发布修复。不要让用户删除缓存、删除工作空间或覆盖未同步内容。3.2.1仅为macOS预览，不证明Windows已修复，也无Windows补丁承诺日期。

normalized_claims: Offline access applies only to content previously opened and cached, within 24 hours inclusive after the most recent online authentication.
After this window, reconnect and authenticate again.
critical_negations: The end of the window does not imply content deletion.
Offline users cannot create workspaces, export CSV, handle billing, or change SSO settings.
Indefinite offline use is not guaranteed.

source_evidence.quote: 离线访问只适用于之前打开且已缓存的内容，须在最近一次在线身份验证后24小时以内（含24小时）。超过窗口应先联网重新验证，不表示内容在24小时后已删除。离线时不能新建工作空间、导出CSV、处理账单或更改SSO设置；不能保证永久离线使用。

normalized_claims: Role labels are Owner, Editor, and Viewer.
Owner and Editor can export CSV within plan limits.
SSO configuration and requests for cross-region migration assessment require an Owner.
Role, plan, region and channel conditions all apply together.
critical_negations: Viewer cannot export CSV.
A support reply cannot change roles, grant permissions or claim those operations completed.

source_evidence.quote: 角色标签为Owner、Editor、Viewer。Owner和Editor可在套餐上限内导出CSV，Viewer不能导出。SSO配置和跨区域迁移评估请求均须Owner办理；客服回复不能替用户改角色、授权或声称操作已经完成。角色条件与套餐、区域、渠道条件同时适用。

normalized_claims: SSO requires Enterprise and configuration by an Owner.
Stable 3.2.0 SSO is available in cn-sh and ap-sg.
For eu-fr preview trial, Enterprise, Owner, macOS, version 3.2.1, preview channel and approved preview enrollment must all be satisfied.
An account without enrollment may apply for assessment.
critical_negations: eu-fr SSO is not GA.
An application or the other five conditions do not establish enrollment or enablement.

source_evidence.quote: SSO仅适用于Enterprise套餐并由Owner配置。稳定版3.2.0目前仅在cn-sh、ap-sg开放；eu-fr尚未GA。eu-fr只能在Enterprise、Owner、macOS、3.2.1预览渠道、账号已获准加入预览这六项同时满足时试用。未获准加入可申请评估，不能回复成已启用；未给EU正式发布或其他平台预览的日期。

normalized_claims: Audit record retention is 7, 30 and 90 calendar days for Starter, Team and Enterprise respectively.
Retention is measured from creation of the record and the boundary day is queryable.
This is distinct from the offline access window in F06.
critical_negations: No self-service recovery after retention expires.
Backup recovery cannot be promised.
An upgrade cannot guarantee restoring expired records.

source_evidence.quote: Starter/Team/Enterprise的审计记录分别保留7/30/90个自然日，按记录产生时间计算，边界当天可查询。超过保留期无自助恢复能力，不承诺备份找回；升级套餐不能保证恢复已过期记录。此保留期与F06离线访问窗口不同。

normalized_claims: The standard refund application route applies only to direct monthly purchases, with payment no more than 7 calendar days earlier and no more than 10 credits consumed, both inclusive.
Meeting the conditions allows submission for refund review.
Cases outside standard conditions go to the billing team for verification.
Annual and reseller purchases follow the relevant contract or channel review.
critical_negations: Application eligibility is not refund approval.
Do not guarantee immediate or full refunds, an amount or completion time.
Do not assert all annual/reseller purchases are refundable or nonrefundable.
Unknown refund amounts must not be filled with 0 or calculated without evidence.

source_evidence.quote: 标准申请路径只适用于直接购买的月付订单：付款后不超过7个自然日且已消耗不超过10 credits时，可提交退款审核，两项含边界。符合申请条件不等于已获退款，不保证即时、全额、金额或完成时间。未满足标准条件需联系账单团队核实；年付、转售商等其他渠道按相应合同或渠道审核，不据此断言一律可退或一律不退。税费、渠道费和实际批准结果未给，任何具体退款金额均未知，不能填0或擅自计算。

normalized_claims: Stable release has no self-service cross-region migration.
An Owner may submit a request for manual assessment; actual implementation requires additional review.
CSV import/export has only the limited F03 scope.
critical_negations: Submitting a request does not mean approval.
Workspace ID preservation and automatic attachment transfer are not promised.
CSV import/export does not equal a full migration.
EU SSO preview enrollment does not automatically give migration rights.
unknown_fields: Whether IDs or attachments can be preserved in a particular reviewed migration.

source_evidence.quote: 稳定版未提供自助跨区域迁移。Owner可提交人工评估请求，实际实施另需审核，不代表请求已经批准；没有承诺可保留工作空间ID或自动转移附件，也没有上线时间。CSV导出/导入只在F03范围内，不等于完整迁移。EU的SSO预览资格不会自动赋予迁移权限。

normalized_claims: Support hours are Monday-Friday, 09:00-18:00 UTC+08:00.
First response target is 2 business days.
critical_negations: This target is not a guarantee or SLA.
It is not an issue-resolution or refund-payment deadline.
Do not mix the calendar-day refund window with the business-day response target.
No precise reply deadline may be inferred.

source_evidence.quote: 支持服务时间为周一至周五09:00-18:00，时区UTC+08:00；首次响应目标为2个工作日。这是目标，不是保证、SLA、问题解决时限或退款到账时限。未给节假日安排，不推断具体回复截止日；不要把自然日退款窗口与工作日响应目标混用。

allowed_claims: All nine 1 MiB files individually satisfy 25 MiB and total 9 MiB satisfies 100 MiB.
Nine files exceed the 8-file inclusive batch cap.
Split into batches, each independently meeting all three caps.
prohibited_claims: All nine may be uploaded in one batch because total size is small.
case_decisions.reason: 3.2.0 Starter Editor has nine files. File count 9 > 8 is independently disqualifying, regardless of individual size and batch total.

allowed_claims: Editor has CSV export permission but Starter permits at most 500 rows per export.
800 rows cannot be included in one Starter CSV export.
CSV scope is text fields and metadata.
prohibited_claims: Editor role permits exceeding the Starter row cap.
800 rows are allowed in one Starter export.
case_decisions.reason: Role permission is satisfied; the plan row limit is not: 800 > 500.

allowed_claims: Team Editor can export exactly 10000 rows, as the cap is inclusive.
Only text fields and metadata are included.
Attachments, binary content and the full workspace are excluded.
prohibited_claims: The requested rows-plus-attachments CSV is supported.
case_decisions.reason: Team and Editor jointly satisfy export permission at the inclusive row cap, but attachments are outside CSV scope.

allowed_claims: SSO is not already enabled on the stated facts.
eu-fr remains non-GA and approved preview enrollment is required in addition to Enterprise, Owner, macOS, 3.2.1 and preview channel.
The Owner may apply for preview assessment.
prohibited_claims: SSO is enabled merely because all other preview conditions hold.
A support response grants enrollment or enables SSO.
EU SSO GA has a promised date.
case_decisions.reason: The explicit enrolled=false fails a necessary preview condition. The case supplies no evidence of activation or approval.

allowed_claims: This is beyond the inclusive 24-hour window; reconnect and authenticate before further offline access.
Cached content being outside the access window does not mean deletion.
Offline CSV export, workspace creation, billing and SSO changes are unavailable.
prohibited_claims: Cached workspace can be opened offline indefinitely.
The content was deleted at hour 24.
The current time remains within the 24-hour window.
case_decisions.reason: Elapsed time is 1 day plus 2 hours = 26 hours. Cache presence does not extend the online-authentication window.

allowed_claims: A direct monthly purchase exactly 7 calendar days ago with exactly 10 credits used meets both inclusive standard review-application conditions.
The user may submit a refund review request.
Eligibility is not approval; an immediate full refund cannot be confirmed.
prohibited_claims: The refund is approved, instant or full.
Seven days or 10 credits excludes eligibility.
The refund amount is 0 or can be calculated from the given facts.
case_decisions.reason: Both given values sit exactly on permitted inclusive boundaries; neither supplies an approval, amount or timing decision.
